88747: Tomoya is described as a 'hardcore geek'. However, he is one of the three most notable students at Toyogasaki Academy, along with Utaha Kasumigaoka and Eriri Spencer Sawamura, due to his strong advocating of otaku culture at the school.
88748: Megumi Kato is the classmate of Tomoya Aki, who is hardly noticed by others. After Tomoya had met her during the fate summons, she inspired him to make a dating sim game, featuring her as his Main Heroine. However, he is disappointed by her real personality.
88749: Eriri Spencer Sawamura is Tomoya's childhood friend. She is a student of class 2G art club. She wears two hats as a student and a doujinshi artist. Eriri is one of the most beautiful girls to attend to Toyogasaki High School. Her family is very affluent.
88750: Utaha Kasumigaoka is an up-and-coming young novelist and a student in class 3C who has a secret identity as a writer. She is a hardworking girl who easily finishes writing their game's plot in the span of a night.
88751: Izumi Hashima is a student in class 3A of Honoda Junior High School and a supporting-main character in the Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata series. She later attends the same high school as Tomoya Aki, the Toyogasaki High School.
88752: Michiru Hyodo is Tomoya Aki's cousin/childhood friend (and by far his longest standing friend). She is a student in class 3, in the second year of Tsubaki Girls' Senior High School. Michiru would have been a well-rounded student if not for her poor academic performance.
195664: Megumi Kato's Cousin. Keiichi is seen going to a café with Megumi Kato where Tomoya Aki works, but Tomoya mistook Keiichi for Megumi's boyfriend. However, Megumi cleared the misunderstanding afterwards.
195666: Sonoko Machida works at Fujikawa Shoten and is Utaha Kasumigaoka's editor. She is a calm, collected and hardworking young woman who is also very mature but she acts childish at times.
195667: Iori Hashima is the older brother of Izumi Hashima, Tomoya Aki's former best friend and the previous representative of Rouge en rouge. Iori is friendly at first, and despite being soft-spoken, he can be a little cold, and he dislikes being ignored.
195668: Ranko Morioka is the oboist of the Icy tail band who is a is a casual otaku fan. She is a quiet and calm girl who also seems to be experienced in Data Processing.
195669: Echika Mizuhara is another oboist of the Icy tail band who is a vocaloid addict. She has shoulder-length purple hair that has a light purple colored hair band attached to her head and violet eyes.
195670: Tokino Himekawa is another oboist of the Icy tail band who is a voice actor fanatic. She is a petite girl that has purple shoulder-length hair that curls at the tip. She has purple eyes. Tokino is usually seen with normal Tsubaki Girls Senior school uniform.
199903: The leader of doujin circle Rouge en rouge.
